comparison.objective: Orient and insert an 18650 cell into a spot welder, then latch its lid.
comparison.physical_skill: Reorientation, close-clearance placement, fixture stabilization, and snap-latching.
comparison.success_condition: Cell seated positive-end-first, lid caught shut, welder reoriented and released; dropped or reversed cells fail.
comparison.reason: Close-clearance insertion and latching differ materially from driving a mandrel by hammer impact to fracture a sacrificial tang and recover the released fragment without disturbing the insert.
